milestones.note: Your primary skill - launches a flying demon head in a direction.
Survival skill. Aim for 100% uptime on this the whole way through.

Unlocks the Soul Shard mechanic. Orbital Scream changes the playstyle: the demon skull orbits you and deals damage automatically. Briefly channel Blazing Scream to keep the skull's orbit and duration up.
The big payoff skill in this build. The core of your damage from here on.
Fallen Army gains Abyss Recast. Sacrificial Fragment becomes an alternative to Legion Shard as your Soul Shard.

strategy: Put ranks into your main skill (Blazing Scream) first, then utility. Spam Blazing Scream whenever Wrath is available.

paragon.note: Level glyphs first to 50, then 100, then 150. Prioritize survivability over damage early - hit minimum glyph requirements instead of maxing them out. A 'Push' variant swaps in Ritualism (large damage multiplier via Sigil of Subversion) plus Death Aura and Ichor Carapace for survivability.
